description: This Java class, NotFoundFallbackController, provides a fallback endpoint in a Spring Boot application to handle unmapped paths, returning a 404 JSON response for unknown routes. It prevents static resources and admin endpoints from triggering the fallback.

classes.name: NotFoundFallbackController
classes.description: Controller to handle fallback for unmapped paths, providing custom 404 responses.

methods.name: notFound
methods.description: Handles all unmatched routes, returning a structured 404 JSON response unless the path is in the allowlist.

methods.name: startsWithAny
methods.description: Checks if the request path starts with any of the specified prefixes, used to determine whether to handle the request or delegate.
